_comment: Curated CH employers on public ATS boards. Slugs MUST be verified before adding: GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs (200 = ok) or https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json. Many companies' careers page text differs from their ATS slug.
_unverified_candidates: Nexthink, Frontify, SonarSource, Squirro, Smallpdf, Acronis, Beekeeper, Sherpany, Yokoy, Numbrs were probed and returned 404 — likely on different ATS or under different slug. Verify by inspecting their /careers page Network tab.
